contrast: per-extension: .ps1/.psm1/.bat/.cmd on Windows emit UTF-8 BOM or ASCII; .md/.json/agent/skill defs strip a leading BOM
hypothesis: A puncheon is the punch that strikes the mark; the UTF-8 BOM is the mark that tells the reader this is UTF-8. Without it, PowerShell 5.1 assays the metal as ANSI and the em-dash strike comes out a quotation mark.
